title: Aureline M5 correction-conversion report
description: Canonical per-domain release-room report minted by the deferral-backlog and correction-conversion lane over the frozen M5 stable-line-protection matrix. Records the outcome a bounded launch-era 'may slip to v1.0.x' deferral was driven to on its supported line: a shipped correction (the deferred work landed as a v1.0.x correction), an explicit defer (the item was formally deferred to a named later train), or a claim narrowing (the item missed its promised correction train, so the related public/support claim was narrowed automatically). Names the conversion scope, binds the resolved line identity, the affected-claim reference, the target-train reference, and the active conversion reason so release, help, About, support, and public-proof surfaces can distinguish shipped corrections, explicit defers, and unresolved scope debt still affecting supported-line claims rather than leaving a launch-time caveat to linger as folklore. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a line's correction-conversion posture by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
